changes: Adds experiments/recovery-runner/make-fig-gate-ablation.mjs — a committed, reproducible generator that rebuilds the section 5/6 evidence-gate ablation figure from powered/*.jsonl (dedup keep-first by arm|taskId|scenarioId|repeat, counts adjudicatedOutcome, emits a standalone SVG + tidy CSV, with a hard conflict-guard on ambiguous dedup + a raw->unique transparency line); a 43-assertion offline selfcheck wired as the 8th check in run-selfchecks.mjs; and a README section documenting it.
usage: node experiments/recovery-runner/make-fig-gate-ablation.mjs [poweredDir] [outPrefix] -> writes fig-gate-ablation.svg + .csv and prints per-arm amplification; node experiments/recovery-runner/make-fig-gate-ablation-selfcheck.mjs (offline, 43 assertions); node experiments/recovery-runner/run-selfchecks.mjs (8/8).
expectedOutcome: Running the generator on the real powered/ prints A4 2/1920 (0.10%), A2prime 31/1920 (1.61%), A3 14/1920, A2 18/1920, A1 13/1560, a 'dedup: 18557 raw -> 9240 unique' line, and writes the SVG+CSV; run-selfchecks reports all 8 passing offline.
actualTranscript: Verified live: 'dedup: 18557 raw records -> 9240 unique cells (9317 duplicate re-runs dropped)', 'A4 amplified 2/1920 = 0.10%', selfcheck '43 assertions passed, 0 failed', run-selfchecks 'all 8 recovery-runner selfchecks passed (offline, no live LLM)'; done_required_validate PASS (packages/main build + root full npm test).
outcomeDiff: No difference — actual matches expected exactly (numbers reproduce analyze.mjs on the deduped matrix).
limitations: The figure dedups internally to the 9240-cell matrix; analyze.mjs does NOT dedup, so analyze must be run on deduped input to match (documented in README). The generator only counts adjudicatedOutcome; the bootstrap CI stays in analyze.mjs and inserting the figure into the paper is a separate manual step (both out of scope, owned by the analysis/paper workstream).
pitfalls: High-assurance ProofStory gate auto-triggered by the word 'gate' in the story text -> required original_intent_snapshot + intent_collision + scope_contract + acceptance-binding + red-evidence, plus scope_contract_acknowledge for the 4 Lattice-generated metadata json (fail-closed out-of-scope). Adversarial test-intent caught 2 REAL robustness bugs (nonexistent-dir ENOENT crash + empty-dir misleading all-zero artifacts) -> fixed. codex host-2 caught the real dedup/analyze consistency hazard all 4 claude lanes missed (F-002) -> fixed via conflict-guard + transparency. finding_resolve is REVIEW-only (rejected in DEV). Next person: always run analyze on DEDUPED input; keep the dedup key byte-identical to any future analyze dedup.
